title: Mailer Template Error:  the return value of  TemplateProducer.template() is null
body:
### Describe the bug

I use the following checked templates with quarkus mailer:
```
@CheckedTemplate
public class Templates {
  public static native MailTemplate.MailTemplateInstance success(String name);

  public static native MailTemplate.MailTemplateInstance error(String name);
}
```
I'm able to use those template in dev mode and in test. but when the jar is built, It's throwing an NPE.

### Expected behavior

The mail is templated correctly

### How to Reproduce?

Reproducer: https://github.com/rmanibus/quarkus_18736

1) mvn install
2) mvn quarkus:dev 
3) curl localhost:8080/hello -> template is working
4) mvn install && java -jar target/code-with-quarkus-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-runner.jar
5) curl localhost:8080/hello -> an exception is thrown
